english.meaning: in the pattern 點 ... 法, asks or exclaims about the manner, as in how on earth
english.note: 點可憐法 means how pitiful, in what way. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Yeah. Or tell them how pitiful it is.
exampleSentences.traditional: 係啊。一係話俾佢聽點可憐法囖。
